title: Microstrip on alumina (εr = 9.8, h = 0.635 mm, W = 0.6 mm) shorted to its ground floor by a 0.4 mm via 4 mm from its port, at 2 GHz
source: E. Hammerstad, Ø. Jensen, Accurate models for microstrip computer-aided design, IEEE MTT-S Int. Microwave Symp. Dig., 1980, pp. 407–409 (Z0, ε_eff); M. E. Goldfarb, R. A. Pucel, Modeling via hole grounds in microstrip, IEEE Microwave Guided Wave Lett. 1(6):135–137, 1991 (the via's inductance, 98 pH); S11 = Γ e^{−2jβL} referred to the line; evaluated independently of the code: `cargo run --release -p emcraft-theory --example pcb_via_reference -- 0.600075 0.635 9.8 4 0.4 2`

quantities.reason: lossless and shorted: everything comes back

+0.27° measured: the via's inductance turns S11 by 2.8° from an ideal short at its centre (Goldfarb–Pucel's fit, a few per cent, against the 12-sided barrel and its pad), the line by 2βL (checked to 0.005° by pcb-microstrip-fem); an open end would be 180° away
